item.title: Contratto di ricerca: An Interdisciplinary social science project using audiovisual methods to investigate democratic practices, produce ethnographic knowledge, and communicate research through documentaries, podcasts, and digital storytelling (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-21 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-02 Scienza politica

The position involves research, organizational, and project development activities that contribute to the further development of the UNREAL Lab. Additional research activities in the context of other research projects on similar topics may be defined in due course with the mutual agreement between research contract holder and supervisor. If the supervision of this activity taking place within another project is done in detail by a different professor/researcher, the main supervisor has to explicitly countersign the part of the report regarding the activity on additional research projects.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 research contract - Department of Sociology and Business Law (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-19 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-07 Sociologia della politica, del diritto e della devianza

Title of the project: “Using Liberal Tools for Illiberal Missions (ULTIM): CCSOs” - Postdoc 4 (PD 4) focuses on the political-sociological analysis of the political mobilization of European CCSOs. PD4 will have relevant competences in civil society analysis, social movements studies, and network analysis, and engages in a literature review on forms of public claims-making, advocacy, and lobbying. PD4 and 3 will create the prosopographies of the most important CCSOs. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-19 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-07 Sociologia della politica, del diritto e della devianza

Title of the project: “Using Liberal Tools for Illiberal Missions (ULTIM): European Parliament” - Postdoc 3 (PD3) focuses on the political-sociological analysis of relations and affinities between CCSOs and political actors, particularly in relation to the European Parliament. PD3 engages in a literature review on intra-parliamentary relations, EP party groups, Bourdieusian fields, network analysis, epistemic communities, and prosopographies of collective actors. PD3 engages in mapping the composition of committees and intergroups, identifying relevant chairs and rapporteurs, and engage in fieldwork and interviews, reconstructing connections between CCSOs and political actors. Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-07 Sociologia della politica, del diritto e della devianza

Title of the project: “Using Liberal Tools for Illiberal Missions (ULTIM): CJEU” - Postdoc 2 (PD2) focuses on legal mobilization in relation to the CJEU, while assisting PD1. Duties consist in a literature review, the analysis of case-law, and the analysis of Advocate General opinions as well as compliance to relevant CJEU judgments. PD2 executes a (socio-)legal discourse analysis of case-law, third-party interventions or other forms of third-party engagement, and related statements and documents issued by CCSOs..Omissis.

Title of the project: “Using Liberal Tools for Illiberal Missions (ULTIM): ECtHR” - Postdoc 1 (PD1) focuses on legal mobilization in relation to the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR), while assisting PD2.
